integrity: Explicit self-contained proof and finite-field computational corroboration; no claim of independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Only k-linear local derivations on the exact free class-two Lie algebra for n>=3; no assertion for arbitrary quotients, higher nilpotency class, or nonlinear two-local maps. The 2015 and 2024 papers give foundational and existence results; available partial 2026 literature means historical priority is not exhaustively certified. Self-review only; independent audit not performed.
title: Local derivation spaces of free class-two Lie algebras and the modular exterior-square defect
